title: Concept: Authorization decision carried in a hidden field
description: A hidden role field is an authorization decision handed to the client: anyone who edits the form controls the value, so the server must never treat it as authoritative.
applicability: Admin consoles, user-management forms and single-page apps that render the current role into the form.
risk: An attacker raises their own privilege, or grants one to another account, by editing a request the server already accepts.
